annotations.title: Search email-reading rules (hacks) other people shared

description: Searches the hacks people share with the community, by sender (like chase.com) or name. Each has its fields, how many people use copies, how many of those read a message in the last 30 days (working) or stopped matching (stopped), and an example message. Before building a hack for a sender, look here: a shared one that's working saves the person an AI suggestion.

query.description: A sender's domain or address, or words in the hack's name. Leave out for the most used.
